boards.title: 10 Late-Night Runs That Explain University of Chicago
boards.description: Ten food-focused destinations with directly documented evening or overnight availability near the University of Chicago.

cards.title: Baker Dining Commons Fourth Meal
cards.subtitle: 5500 S. University Ave. · UChicago campus
cards.notes: Use the published fourth-meal window for a campus dining stop after regular dinner service; confirm quarter and break schedules before heading over.
cards.short_summary: A documented late campus dining period at Baker.
cards.evidence_claim: UChicago Dining’s Spring 2026 hours list Baker Fourth Meal from 9 p.m. to midnight Monday through Thursday.
cards.access_notes: Published for Monday–Thursday, 9 p.m.–midnight during Spring Quarter 2026; dining locations may change during breaks.

cards.title: Maroon Market
cards.subtitle: 5640 S. University Ave. · Bartlett Hall
cards.notes: Pick up packaged food or drinks from the market when a late campus errand is more useful than a full meal; check holiday notices first.
cards.short_summary: A campus market with a published 1 a.m. closing time.
cards.evidence_claim: UChicago Dining’s Spring 2026 hours list Maroon Market as open daily from 10 a.m. to 1 a.m.
cards.access_notes: Published daily hours are 10 a.m.–1 a.m. for Spring Quarter 2026; verify break-period changes before visiting.

cards.title: Midway Market
cards.subtitle: 6031 S. Ellis Ave. · Campus South
cards.notes: Use this market for a late snack or drink near the south end of campus, and review current dining notices when the academic calendar shifts.
cards.short_summary: A second campus market with published nightly availability.
cards.evidence_claim: UChicago Dining’s Spring 2026 hours list Midway Market as open daily from 10 a.m. to 1 a.m.
cards.access_notes: Published daily hours are 10 a.m.–1 a.m. for Spring Quarter 2026; verify break-period changes before visiting.

cards.entity_name: Pret A Manger at University of Chicago
cards.title: Pret A Manger at University of Chicago
cards.subtitle: 5706 S. University Ave. · Hutchinson Commons area
cards.notes: Plan a food or coffee stop before the listed 11 p.m. close, using the campus dining schedule rather than assuming the same hours during breaks.
cards.short_summary: A campus Pret location listed through 11 p.m.
cards.evidence_claim: UChicago Dining’s Spring 2026 hours list Pret A Manger at 5706 S. University Ave. open until 11 p.m. daily.
cards.access_notes: Published closing time is 11 p.m. daily for Spring Quarter 2026; check current campus dining updates during breaks.

cards.title: Capriotti's at Midway Cafe
cards.subtitle: 6031 S. Ellis Ave. · Campus South
cards.notes: Time this sandwich counter for its posted evening service, and confirm the academic-quarter schedule before making it your late campus stop.
cards.short_summary: An evening sandwich option at Midway Café.
cards.evidence_claim: UChicago Dining’s Spring 2026 hours list Capriotti’s at Midway Café from 6 p.m. to midnight Sunday through Thursday.
cards.access_notes: Published Sunday–Thursday hours are 6 p.m.–midnight for Spring Quarter 2026; availability can vary on breaks.

cards.title: Ex Libris Café
cards.subtitle: Regenstein Library · UChicago campus
cards.notes: Pair a snack or espresso drink with library time, allowing enough margin before the listed 10:30 p.m. close on its late-service days.
cards.short_summary: A student-run café inside Regenstein Library.
cards.evidence_claim: UChicago Student Centers lists Ex Libris Café hours until 10:30 p.m. Monday through Thursday and Sunday, with snacks and espresso drinks.
cards.access_notes: Listed hours are until 10:30 p.m. Monday–Thursday and Sunday; it is on Regenstein Library’s first floor.

cards.title: Cheesie's at Tiffin Café
cards.subtitle: 1414 E. 59th St. · International House
cards.notes: Check building access before going, then use the posted evening window for grilled-cheese fare at the International House café location.
cards.short_summary: A late food counter inside International House.
cards.evidence_claim: Cheesie’s lists its University of Chicago Tiffin Café location at 1414 E. 59th St. with service until midnight daily.
cards.access_notes: Cheesie’s lists 7:30–10:30 a.m. and 4 p.m.–midnight daily; the location is within I-House and has limited access.

cards.title: Sky Café
cards.subtitle: Center for Care and Discovery · 5700 S. Maryland Ave.
cards.notes: For an overnight food option beside campus, follow hospital visitor guidance and use the café’s published overnight service window rather than assuming vendor hours.
cards.short_summary: A hospital café with overnight food service.
cards.evidence_claim: UChicago Medicine lists Sky Café overnight service from 10 p.m. to 6 a.m. daily and says the café is open 24 hours a day, seven days a week.
cards.access_notes: Published overnight service is 10 p.m.–6 a.m. daily; the café is at 5700 S. Maryland Ave. in the hospital’s Center for Care and Discovery.

cards.title: Insomnia Cookies Hyde Park
cards.subtitle: 1105 E. 55th St. · Hyde Park
cards.notes: Use the bakery’s published late closing times for a dessert pickup near campus, checking the day-specific schedule before setting out.
cards.short_summary: A Hyde Park cookie shop with late daily hours.
cards.evidence_claim: Apple Maps lists Insomnia Cookies at 1105 E. 55th St. with closing times of 1 a.m. Sunday–Wednesday and 3 a.m. Thursday–Saturday.
cards.access_notes: Listed hours: until 1 a.m. Sunday–Wednesday and until 3 a.m. Thursday–Saturday; confirm the day’s service before traveling.

cards.title: Nella Pizza e Pasta
cards.subtitle: 1125 E. 55th St. · Hyde Park
cards.notes: Reserve or order a meal before the venue’s stated 10 p.m. close; use its official page for current menu and contact details.
cards.short_summary: A nearby Neapolitan restaurant open into the evening.
cards.evidence_claim: Nella Pizza e Pasta’s official site lists its Hyde Park location at 1125 E. 55th St. and hours until 10 p.m. every day.
cards.access_notes: The official site lists 10 a.m.–10 p.m. Sunday through Thursday and Friday through Saturday; confirm service details before visiting.

warnings: Several campus dining sources publish quarter-specific hours; access notes identify the stated period and advise checking break-period changes.
